turn_text: Yes. So as we talk about our safe economic recovery during the COVID pandemic, but certainly after the COVID pandemic, making sure that we have investment into our workforce of the future is going to be critical. First of all, this bill is bipartisan. That was important to me because I want to see improvements made and funding provided for workforce development. So I worked with my colleague and classmate Seth Moulton. We were elected the same year. He's from Massachusetts to introduce this legislation. And we got feedback not only from local constituents in our districts, but organizations like yours. This is designed to really build upon and supplement the existing workforce investments through WIOA. and meet the increased need for reskilling, particularly in light of the recent jobs reports, revealing that while more people are going back to work, there are a significant number of Americans who may face permanent job loss. So we want to make sure that that skills development and workforce development, those resources are available for our workforce of the future. The bill will establish personal reemployment accounts to help displaced workers obtain the training and skills they need for long-term sustained employment. So these accounts are provided to individuals identified as most in need of additional job training. And importantly, they're administered by the local workforce boards through the one-stop career centers. And that was really important to me because we wanted to utilize the strong existing structure of the WIOA and workforce boards, which I visited in my district. So the individuals that receive those accounts are able to use the funds to purchase those training services And there's also an incentive for these individuals to gain in demand skills, and then of course secure a full-time job. So there's an incentive payment after they complete their training and are re-employed. So this is about getting folks safely back to work, but most importantly broadening the aperture when we consider education, training, vocational certificates, and making sure people are able to match up with jobs of the future.
